option_relations.rationale: The option describes a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, which matches the characteristics of the κ light chain–restricted B-cell Lymphoma.
Leptomeningeal lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (LPL) is a subtype of B-cell lymphoma, and the κ light chain–restricted B-cell Lymphoma could be a specific instance of LPL.
Waldenström macroglobulinemia is a distinct lymphoproliferative disorder, and there is no clear connection to the patient's presentation or the κ light chain–restricted B-cell Lymphoma.
The option describes leptomeningeal involvement by relapsed B-cell lymphoma, which matches the characteristics of lymphomatous meningitis.
